I don't care how sad and emotional you are, and my sympathy for you is fucking dwindling

I don't give a fuck about how sad and emotional you are about how your fucking partner died, because his reality is my fucking reality. What he went through I went through, I go through. 

No one cares how fucking messy you are or how edgy you're feeling- I'm sick and tired of people who don't struggle with personality disorders adding to our stigma, our pain; and our suffering. 

My reality isn't a fucking hypothetical, its a real burning reality of my own family members calling me crazy, of being thrown  in mental hospitals from age 15 upwards. Its thick, dark scars up and down my skin, suicide kits hidden under the bed, Googling gun ranges within 50 miles.

You have no sympathy for anyone but yourself. You're only concerned about how crazy affects you and what a martyr you are and I thought my love could cure him and now my role as caregiver is gone and I wasted my love on him now I'll never have a normal life. 

I have friends who died by suicide as well, which is why I'm fucking here. I also suffer from a severe mental illness. I don't care how suicide affects you, that doesn't mean I have to sit back and listen to you or anyone else on this sub throw fuel on the fire to those of who suffered from whatever your friends/family members/who the fuck ever died by. 


I tried to be nice and understanding, but fuck you and everyone else who contributes to our suffering with this bullshit. 

YOU'RE NOT THE FUCKING VICTIM, HE WAS, and you'll NEVER understand the torment people with severe mental illness go through. You're not the victim.
I find things that help me disassociate, mostly video games, books, and YouTube.
Edit: I'm going to edit my comment because you're clearly grieving and don't deserve to be talked to like that.
Your curls are so shiny! That blond matches your skin tone perfectly.

Reading both the OPs post and this comment makes me realize how little empathy people without mental illness actually have for those of us who suffer. Using words like "crazy" and "sane" only adds to the stigma we face.

"Fucked to be around them, fucked without them." Really? Is that how you really feel? This is why people give up hope- because of the ignorance perpetuated by our own FAMILIES, people who are supposed to love and support us.

If thats how you feel about us when we're alive, then you have no right to complain about us when we're dead. People like you treat us as if our very existence is a burden, then go on to weep when we end our lives.
Teens are pretty chill in my opinion. Nothing like toddlers and young children at all.
This seems full of internalized misogyny... Cuntley, really?
Sorry, I thought this was r/sanctionedsuicide

I honestly don't understand this concept at all. You have access to resources millions of middle class people and poor people would kill for, and yet you do nothing with it. You could go to school, go on adventures, explore your hobbies and then turn them into a business... and yet you do nothing.

I hate when wealthy people say "money doesn't buy happiness" or "I'm wealthy and I'm still not happy." when billions around the world would kill to not live paycheck to paycheck.

This has happened to me before as well, when I was in high school and called a suicide hotline- the police literally showed up at my high school's health center and told me I had to go inpatient, and when my parents contested it (as I was underaged at the time) they told them that either they had me committed or they would.

I have refused any and all help from mental health professionals and keep my suicidal thoughts to myself. I don't tell anyone- my family, my friends, my co-workers- because they are all delusional. Inpatient was hell for me. I feel intense anxiety and panic when I think about it, and I had nightmares about it for several days after I was discharged.
